text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"longer multi-paragraph argument with transitions like \"In the end\" and \"Also\"","quality":"organizational control","description":"This captures clearer paragraphing and more deliberate progression of ideas across the essay."},{"evidence":"more sustained support such as \"can help grow that person professionally\" and \"mentor... help them grow their leadership skills\"","quality":"development of ideas","description":"This captures fuller explanation and elaboration of claims rather than brief or repetitive assertions."},{"evidence":"fewer severely garbled phrases than B's \"the way they was raise\" and \"wot be that hard getting it done will be\"","quality":"sentence clarity","description":"This captures a higher level of understandable sentence construction with fewer breakdowns in meaning."},{"evidence":"use of varied connectors like \"also,\" \"first,\" \"second,\" and \"In the end\"","quality":"cohesive linking","description":"This captures more explicit linking of points within and between paragraphs."},{"evidence":"more controlled formal register with extended persuasive phrasing","quality":"academic tone","description":"This captures a more consistently essay-like and audience-aware voice."}]}
